values.note: $25 a night for a single site, $40 for a double; electric sites are $7 more ($32 single, $47 double). Senior and Access pass holders get 50% off the base site fee, not the hookup fee. First-come sites are paid by Scan & Pay in the recreation.gov app, or cash/check at the fee station. Day use $8 a vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/trout-pond-recreation-area ('$25 per single campsite per night. $40 per double campsite per night. $7 E-hookup fee.', last updated 2026-05-06) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232162/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $25, STANDARD ELECTRIC $32, doubles $40/$47), read 2026-10-20

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/trout-pond-recreation-area ('The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Pass provides a 50% discount to the base campsite fee (not hook ups)'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campground available from early May through October (no opening day published); day use April-December.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/trout-pond-recreation-area (Seasons of Use: 'Campground available from early May – October.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Some sites are reservable on recreation.gov; the rest are first-come single sites paid by Scan & Pay on arrival. A reservation that includes a weekend must take Friday and Saturday together. 14 nights per visit and 14 in any rolling 30 days. Entrance gates locked 10 p.m. to 8 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/trout-pond-recreation-area (Reservations: maximum stays, 'Two Night Weekend Minimum'; 'We currently accept reservations for some campsites ... Scan & Pay ... for a first come-first served campsite') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232162 (notice 'This facility has first-come, first-serve single sites'; gate notice), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Hot showers and flush toilets a short walk from each site, early May through October.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/trout-pond-recreation-area (Restrooms and showers early May - October; potable water) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232162 ('Hot showers and flush toilets are an easy walk away from each site'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 46 campsites in the recreation.gov catalog (35 reservable, 11 first-come; 11 electric, 3 doubles) plus a group picnic shelter. Two pull-throughs (35, 39). Listed lengths run 30-45 ft, with several sites at a placeholder-looking 99 ft.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232162 (47 records: 46 overnight sites + group shelter; Driveway Entry Pull-Through on 035 and 039), read 2026-10-20
